verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a card issuing product covering virtual and physical cards, spend controls, and wallet provisioning, so this axis applies. However, the evidence contains nothing about hosted components, iframes, or ephemeral-key flows for showing cardholders their PAN or CVV. There is also no vendor statement about keeping developers out of PCI SAQ D scope.

support.subject: As a developer, I can show cardholders their own PAN and CVV without inheriting PCI scope — hosted components or ephemeral-key reveal flows the vendor documents as keeping me out of SAQ D
